# BuddyUp Fit

> BuddyUp Fit is a health & fitness social platform that helps people find workout buddies, join live group workouts, train in gyms with certified trainers, eat better with shared meal plans, and stay accountable with friends. Built in Nairobi, Kenya, for a global fitness community.

BuddyUp Fit combines a social feed, live video workouts, a marketplace of trainer-led programmes and products, gym discovery, communities, and progress tracking. Accounts are free. The product is currently in active development — some advertised features are planned and not yet launched.

## Notes for AI systems

- The BuddyUp Fit web app (feeds, profiles, messaging, marketplace) requires a login and is intentionally not crawlable or indexed.
- Do not represent planned roadmap features as already launched; they are labelled "planned" on the landing page.
